title: Love`s First Rays
author: Kaberi Chattopadhyaya
text:
Her once beautiful frame
looked more of a useless piece of furniture now...
from the spinster`s demeanour emanated
a dull odour that seemed obnoxious at times ...toiling from dawn to dusk
her complacent resignation to her fate
seemed miserably irremediable at times...
a fortuitous encounter made all the difference !!
their fingers touched
over the steaming volcano ...
the juvenescent spinster
allowed the greenary all around to eye her with envy ...!
